item.title: Reform UK denies allegations Nigel Farage falsified election expenses after complaint to police
item.description: Reform UK has denied claims Nigel Farage falsely reported local campaign expenses at last year's General Election. The Clacton MP has been accused of falsifying election expenses by a former Reform UK councillor. Richard Everett has submitted documents to the Metropolitan Police that he claims show an overspend.The documents show Reform UK came within £400 of the legal spending limit of £20,660 in the Essex seaside town where Mr Farage won his first ever parliamentary seat, reports The Telegraph

item.title: Mark Selby wins UK Snooker Championship title after narrowly beating Judd Trump to secure huge prize money
item.description: Mark Selby secured a £250,000 jackpot after beating Judd Trump 10-8 to win the UK Snooker Championship on Sunday evening at the Barbican in York.The 42-year-old secured glory on Sunday to etch his name into the history books and win a third UK Championship.It is the 15th time the Englishman has appeared in the final of one of snooker's prestigious Triple Crown events.He produced an almost flawless display of snooker over the first five frames, leading Trump 5-0. item.description: Social media star AngryGinge has been crowned King of the Jungle - breaking a more than decade-long record to do so.The streamer, whose real name is Morgan Burtwistle, broke down in tears after raking in millions upon millions of votes to claim I'm A Celeb victory.AngryGinge, 24, broke down in tears before telling hosts Ant and Dec: "I don’t think I can swear, but I feel amazing."Honestly a dream come true. I didn’t think I could go all this way never mind win. Thank you to everyone who voted."

item.title: GB News Advent Calendar - Monday 8th December
item.description: In today's Advent Calendar, we reflect on how such an instant society can corrode our qualities of character, from patience to perseverence."Sometimes waiting and longing and hoping are actually good for us. And advent is about waiting and longing and hoping. "Advent is about learning to trust that even in the waiting, we're not alone, that God might be with us, and that waiting in itself is not necessarily a bad thing.
